scope: Native Mac calendar cards in compact Week, 3 Days and 5 Days layouts, with a wide-layout return check; independently owned Mac implementation.
baselineDefect: At 1080pt without the day-panel task table, selected cards ignored Return and Space.
The combined accessibility element inherited completion as its primary action; selecting a card could complete it. The synthetic completion was immediately undone.
implementation: Cards own keyboard focus and selection. Return opens details, Space toggles completion, Up/Down moves within the day, and Escape clears selection and returns calendar focus. Modified shortcuts and key repeats are not intercepted.
Accessibility primary action selects; named Open in Inspector and Complete/Reopen actions are separate. Status, planned time and project remain in the accessible value.

Only the explicit DEBUG local grammar fixture starts with Backend(session:nil), avoiding an unrelated cloud Keychain read. Normal, Release and authenticated fixtures retain their existing startup path.

nativeAcceptance.note: Native actions used build v4. Final v6 additionally includes planned-time accessibility metadata; these all-day native cards have no clock value. Timed-card runtime is not claimed.

builds.repair: Extracted the unchanged card content and keyboard handler to reduce type-check complexity.
builds.warning: App-only AppIntents metadata extraction skipped because no AppIntents.framework dependency was present.

regression.name: testCompactCalendarCardsOwnKeyboardFocus
regression.reason: Existing Mac XCTest automation initialization failure was not rerun unchanged. Native CUA actions supply this acceptance.

diagnostics: Initial explicit local fixture startup blocked in SecureSession.read/SecItemCopyMatching; sampled before fixing DEBUG fixture isolation. Corrected local startup needed no Keychain prompt.

After normal Quit, a screen observation launched a bare fixture process without the required arguments. Its arguments and blocked stack were checked, that instance was stopped and the intended explicit fixture was relaunched. This does not establish a product Quit failure.
platformSeparation: Mac source and regression stay in the Mac repository. iOS retains its own TaskRow/editor implementation and receives evidence/status documentation only; no new iOS build or runtime acceptance is claimed.
limits: Month/year grid keyboard journeys and full VoiceOver remain open.
Dark appearance, other accessibility settings and drag/drop were not rechecked in this scoped walk.
Existing local widget completion warning remains visible; this change does not resolve it.
No installed Mac widget or distribution acceptance is inferred.
Existing cloud and Focus test processes were not restarted or modified. Latest existing Focus inspection still shows Inbox without the finished-session sheet; notification Open remains unverified.
